allowedSplitWords.description:
Words in the `allowedSplitWords` are considered correct and can be used as a basis for splitting compound words.

If entries can be split so that all the words in the entry are allowed, then only the individual words are added, otherwise the entire entry is added. This is to prevent misspellings in CamelCase words from being introduced into the dictionary.

If the length is too low, then the dictionary will consider many misspelled words as correct.

compress.description: Setting this value to true will create a `.gz` dictionary file. Use `keepUncompressed` to also keep an uncompressed version.
compress.markdownDescription:
Setting this value to true will create a `.gz` dictionary file.
Use `keepUncompressed` to also keep an uncompressed version.

dictionaryDirectives.description:
Injects `cspell-dictionary` directives into the dictionary header.

Example:

```ini # cspell-dictionary: no-generate-alternatives ```

Known Directives: ```yaml
- split # Tell the dictionary loader to split words
- no-split # Tell the dictionary loader to not split words (default)
- generate-alternatives # Tell the dictionary loader to generate alternate spellings (default)
- no-generate-alternatives # Tell the dictionary loader to not generate alternate spellings ```

```

Known Directives:

- no-split # Tell the dictionary loader to not split words (default)
- generate-alternatives # Tell the dictionary loader to generate alternate spellings (default)
- no-generate-alternatives # Tell the dictionary loader to not generate alternate spellings
```
